label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter directly flows to response.getWriter() without proper sanitization. The split() operation only truncates whitespace-delimited words but does not prevent XSS (attacker can pass <script> tag as first word). X-XSS-Protection header is explicitly disabled ('0'), removing browser-level protection.

evidence.note: User input param flows through doSomething() to response.getWriter() without proper escaping/sanitization
